name: TAF Inpatient Claims Header File
description: The TAF Inpatient Claims Header file contains claim-level records for inpatient hospital services billed to Medicaid. Each record represents one inpatient claim and includes admission/discharge information, diagnosis codes, DRG assignments, and claim payment totals.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: TAF Inpatient Claims Header
description: Claim-level inpatient records from the CMS T-MSIS Analytic Files (TAF). Each row represents one inpatient facility claim submitted to Medicaid, containing header-level information including patient identifiers, admission and discharge dates, principal and secondary diagnoses, DRG codes, and total payment amounts.

content.clm_id: String: Unique claim identifier assigned by CMS
content.msis_ident_num: String: Medicaid system identifier number assigned by the state
content.year: Int32: Reference year of the claim
content.admsn_src_cd: String: Admission source code indicating how the patient was admitted
content.los_day_cnt: Int32: Length of stay in days
content.dgns_prsnt_on_admsn_1: String: Present on admission indicator for principal diagnosis
content.bill_type_cd: String: Type of bill code (e.g., 0111 = Hospital inpatient admit through discharge)
content.npi: String: National Provider Identifier of the billing facility
content.tot_mdcd_pd_amt: Double: Total Medicaid paid amount for the claim
content.tot_alowd_amt: Double: Total allowed amount for the claim
content.tot_othr_insrnc_amt: Double: Total other insurance paid amount
content.mdcr_pd_amt: Double: Medicare payment amount (for dual-eligible beneficiaries)
content.cll_cnt: Int32: Number of claim lines on this header record
